description_en: Queries execution logs by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. The current POP contract exposes only the task and workspace identifiers and returns default log segments
description_zh: 使用 RunSemanticJob 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 返回的 ExecutorJobId 查询执行日志。当前 POP 契约仅暴露任务与工作空间标识，返回默认日志片段
name: GetSemanticJobLog

parameters.help_en: The executor job ID. Use the Data.ExecutorJobId from the RunSemanticJob response or the ExecutorJobId from a ListSemanticJobRuns record
parameters.help_zh: 执行器任务标识，使用 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.ExecutorJobId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 ExecutorJobId
parameters.name: executor_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the task belongs. Use the ProjectId from the CreateSemanticJob response or a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 ProjectId
parameters.name: project_id
